fields.Name: T114 - Dashboard Multi Select Bulk Actions
fields.Description: Exercises the AllowMultiSelect selection-mode branch (EnterSelectionMode, per-item checkboxes, SelectedCount, bulk Move/Delete toolbar) — a distinct interaction mode absent from single-record grid/form tests.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open Data Explorer, then the Dashboards section. In the toolbar click the 'Select' button (check-double icon) to enter multi-select mode. Selection checkboxes should appear on the dashboard cards/rows and the toolbar should switch to a selection toolbar showing an 'N selected' count plus Select-all, Move-to-folder, Delete-selected, and Exit buttons. Select one or more dashboards and confirm the selected count updates. Success is the selection mode UI appearing and responding to selection — you do NOT need to actually delete or move. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A 'Select' button is present and clicking it enters selection mode (checkboxes appear on items and a selection toolbar replaces the normal actions)
The selection toolbar shows a selected-count and Select-all / Move / Delete / Exit controls
Selecting an item updates the 'N selected' count (or a valid empty-state shows if there are no dashboards to select)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
